title: Ability to manually set IOB
body: Is there any other way to manually adjust IOB other than providing fake boluses? The use case is negative IOB that I would like to change to zero when seslnsivity is high and I need to struggle with loop (or disable) to not pull into the hypo because of negaive IOB it tries to reduce.

comments.body: IOB is calculated value not user entry. so no

@zibra 
There is an automation trigger for IOB. As action, you could choose a higher TT or a lower profile %, etc.
